Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT THE FIRST IMAGE ONLY. The second image is a crop identifying the user's rejected sword/hilt defect, NOT an additional composition to reproduce.

The user explicitly demands a STRAIGHT VERTICAL SWORD. Correct the sword in the first image: its current handle, guard and blade join have a visible kink, which is unacceptable. Do not merely straighten the lower blade while leaving the handle angled.

REBUILD ONE GEOMETRICALLY STRAIGHT RIGID SWORD ON A SINGLE VERTICAL AXIS, tip pointing straight down toward the ground, parallel to the left/right edges of the canvas. The center of the pommel, grip, tang, guard socket, blade root, central black fuller and pointed tip must lie on the SAME uninterrupted vertical centerline. The grip must not angle away from the blade. Make the guard's lateral crossbar perpendicular to that axis, with consistent perspective and thickness. Its ornate gold points can flare outward but the central structural body must not kink, twist or wander. Make both cutting edges straight and consistently tapering, no bent blade, no curved central channel, no offset blade root, no zigzag centerline. Show the entire sword point with a little ground margin.

Keep the current sword's black central blade, polished silver cutting edges, sculpted gold thornlike angular trim and ornate guard. Retain its identity and high-end rendering, but structural straightness is more important than copying crooked decoration. Place the vertical sword naturally at the knight's right side (viewer left), with the long blade clear of his leg. Make the sword physically plausible and a sensible length. Adjust ONLY the nearby right hand, fingers and wrist as needed to wrap naturally around the vertical handle; keep the elbow and shoulder pose as close as possible. Five convincing gauntleted digits, thumb opposing fingers, no melted joints, no fingers through metal. Do not add a second weapon.

Preserve the entire rest of the first image: SAME silver-haired adult male face and expression, hairstyle, slim athletic body and proportions, exact white/silver/gold armor and cape design, upright stance and feet, background ruins, platinum/gold aura, lighting, color palette and detailed 2D anime/painterly finish. Preserve the original framing. Change only the sword geometry and its grip. No labels, text, logos, frames or watermarks. This correction must be visibly successful: a plumb-straight vertical line should pass from the pommel through the grip and guard to the sword tip.
